2.15.16
Subreport.Width
The Subreport.Width element specifies the width of a Subreport. This element is optional. If this
element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is
interpreted as the width of the subreport’s container (such as a Rectangle or Body) minus the value of
the Subreport.Left element, if specified.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.Width element.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.Width element.
 <xsd:element name="Width" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
